summary: Completed regression retest for copy crash, history rendering/selectors, history delete success/failure handling, and login→record→upload→process→result smoke flow against external preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: ResultPage delete action (remove) is not wrapped in try/catch, so a delete API failure there can still surface as an uncaught runtime error path unlike HistoryPage.
seed_data_creation: No new seeded credentials. UI smoke created one additional session via upload/process and deleted one history row.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified with Demo credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. History now renders populated sessions with dynamic selectors ([data-testid^='history-row-'], [data-testid^='history-view-'], [data-testid^='history-delete-']). Copy click no longer crashes even when clipboard + fallback copy paths are forced to throw. Delete success and forced failure (intercepted 500) both handled without uncaught UI error.
rca of the issue: Previously reported regressions appear fixed in deployed runtime: copy handler now catches clipboard failures and falls back gracefully; HistoryPage loads sessions with sanitized dynamic testids and wraps delete in try/catch. MOCKED integrations confirmed active in runtime warning banner: MOCKED Sarvam speech-to-text, MOCKED Sarvam translation, MOCKED Gemini prescription extraction.
